mapper.select: SELECT ri.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, oi.title FROM ecom_return_item ri LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = ri.material_id LEFT JOIN ecom_order_item oi ON oi.id = ri.order_item_id WHERE ri.return_id = #{returnId} ORDER BY ri.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ecom_return_item (return_id, order_item_id, material_id, seller_sku, qty, refund_amount, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.returnId}, #{i.orderItemId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.sellerSku}, #{i.qty}, #{i.refundAmount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT ri.order_item_id AS "orderItemId", SUM(ri.qty) AS qty FROM ecom_return_item ri JOIN ecom_return r ON r.id = ri.return_id WHERE r.order_id = #{orderId} AND r.status <> 'CLOSED' GROUP BY ri.order_item_id
